title: Keir Starmer shares post-punk passion and revisits musical past
summary: Prime minister praises Scottish band Orange Juice and shares details about his family life in Radio 3 interview Keir Starmer has said he is a fan of the Scottish post-punk band Orange Juice and northern soul, in a deep dive of his musical tastes and personal life. On BBC Radio 3’s Private Passions , Starmer chose a selection of his favourite music including works by Beethoven, Tchaikovsky and Elgar, and reflected on his own musical journey, which included learning to play violin alongside Norman Cook, AKA Fatboy Slim, at school. title: US and China say trade deal drawing closer as Trump and Xi prepare for meeting

title: Adobe’s Project Indigo camera finally adds iPhone 17 support
